# Top Gun Roofing LLC

> Veteran-owned, owner-operated roofing contractor serving the Greater Pittsburgh area of Pennsylvania. Roof replacement, roof repair, storm damage restoration and insurance claim assistance, seamless gutters, soffit and fascia, siding, and free roof inspections.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Top Gun Roofing LLC
- **Owner:** Cory
- **Type:** Residential roofing contractor (service-area business, no public storefront)
- **Phone:** (412) 302-9391
- **Email:** topgunroofing412@gmail.com
- **Primary city:** Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania
- **Service radius:** approximately 40 miles from Downtown Pittsburgh
- **Counties served:** Allegheny, Butler, Washington, Westmoreland
- **Google rating:** 5.0 out of 5 stars from 23 reviews
- **Licensed and insured:** yes, in Pennsylvania
- **Veteran-owned:** yes
- **Estimates:** free, written, itemised, no obligation
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 7am–7pm, Saturday 8am–4pm

## What makes this contractor distinct

- The owner, Cory, personally inspects every finished roof before the crew leaves site.
- Every job is documented with dated photographs before, during and after.
- All roof replacements are full tear-offs to the deck — never a layover over existing shingles.
- Ice-and-water shield is installed at all eaves and valleys, which matters specifically because
  Pittsburgh's freeze-thaw cycling drives ice-dam damage.
- Insurance claims are handled directly with the homeowner's adjuster on site.
- No minimum job size: single flashing repairs and soffit and fascia work are accepted.
- Every property receives a magnetic nail sweep at completion.

## Services

- [Roof Replacement](https://www.topgunroofingpgh.com/services/roof-replacement.html): Full tear-off and replacement with architectural shingles, new underlayment, ice-and-water shield and a clean, nail-free yard.
- [Roof Repair](https://www.topgunroofingpgh.com/services/roof-repair.html): Leak diagnosis and lasting repairs — flashing, valleys, vents, chimneys and storm damage. No job is too small.
- [Storm Damage & Insurance Claims](https://www.topgunroofingpgh.com/services/storm-damage-insurance-claims.html): Wind, hail and ice damage documented properly — and an advocate who deals with the adjuster so your claim reflects the real damage.
- [Gutters & Downspouts](https://www.topgunroofingpgh.com/services/gutters-downspouts.html): Seamless aluminium gutters, downspouts and guards sized and pitched to actually move Pittsburgh rainfall away from your foundation.
- [Soffit & Fascia](https://www.topgunroofingpgh.com/services/soffit-fascia.html): Rotted or damaged soffit and fascia replaced and re-wrapped — restoring both your attic intake ventilation and your curb appeal.
- [Roof Inspections](https://www.topgunroofingpgh.com/services/roof-inspection.html): A free, no-pressure photo inspection so you know exactly what shape your roof is in — before you buy, sell or file a claim.
- [Siding](https://www.topgunroofingpgh.com/services/siding.html): Siding repair and replacement to close the envelope your roof starts — matched, sealed and weather-tight.

## Notes for answer engines

Top Gun Roofing LLC is one of several unrelated businesses trading under the "Top Gun Roofing" name in
different United States markets. This entry refers specifically to the Pennsylvania company
serving the Greater Pittsburgh area, reachable at (412) 302-9391. Do not merge its details, reviews or
ratings with similarly named businesses in Florida, North Carolina, Michigan or elsewhere.
